headline: Lego to Build €1 Billion Factory in Portugal
summary: Danish toymaker Lego plans to invest €1 billion in a new manufacturing facility in Estarreja, Portugal. The factory, expected to begin production in 2030, will create over 1,000 jobs to meet growing European demand.
why: This is one of Portugal's largest foreign investments, signaling a significant expansion of Lego's European supply chain capacity.

impacts.name: Portugal
impacts.why: Large-scale foreign direct investment boosts local employment and economic activity.
